papers.title_en: Ineffective Occupancy in Heterogeneous GPU Clusters: Prediction, Contribution Analysis, and Readiness-Aware Scheduling
papers.evidence: 面向异构GPU集群的就绪感知调度
papers.tldr: 异构GPU集群中，作业虽已完成放置却可能长期未就绪，阿里轨迹显示52.70%的执行记录属于此类无效占用。论文在不改变放置策略的前提下，以准入时可观测的九项属性预测就绪概率，并据此重排准入顺序。该方法将GPU无效占用比例从43.64%降至27.15%，将八卡及以上请求的有效覆盖率从46.11%提升至63.18%，且不损失容量利用率。研究表明，就绪状态可被预测并纳入调度优化，为缓解稀缺异构GPU浪费提供了新维度。
papers.abstract_en: In heterogeneous GPU clusters, GPUs are costly and scarce, yet placing a job on a machine does not mean that the job becomes ready to run. A large amount of allocated capacity can remain occupied for long periods without producing useful computation, further aggravating the waste of compute resources. On the Alibaba GPU cluster trace we find that, even when GPU capacity is sufficient and placement is complete, 52.70% of execution records never became ready. We term this phenomenon ineffective occupancy. Building on this diagnosis, and keeping the placement policy fixed, we propose Readiness-Aware Scheduling (RAS): it uses only nine attributes observable at admission time to predict readiness probability and reorders admission accordingly. Under a five-fold split grouped by machine, the gradient-boosted model reaches an ROC-AUC of 0.8187. A feature-group contribution analysis shows that the model's score is driven mainly by job profile, duration, and GPU model, with the request-size group contributing least, followed by the scheduling and concurrency group. In GPU terms, RAS reduces the ineffective-occupancy ratio (the share of cluster GPUs held under ineffective occupancy) from 43.64% to 27.15% and raises the effective coverage of large requests (eight GPUs or more) from 46.11% to 63.18%, without sacrificing capacity utilization. Relative to the upper bound obtained by ordering with ground-truth labels, RAS captures 65.1% of the attainable improvement, well above the interpretable rules built only from the contribution-analysis conclusions; the gain therefore comes mainly from predicting with all nine attributes jointly rather than from combining rules built on any single attribute group. These results indicate that readiness status is a measurable, predictable, and optimizable dimension of admission decisions in heterogeneous GPU clusters.

papers.title_en: TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Zhu Wang, Ning Hu, Yifan Guo, Xiu Ma, Bin Guo, Zhiwen Yu
papers.evidence: 面向长上下文推理的GPU端KV缓存管理架构
papers.tldr: 长上下文大模型推理的提示词预填充阶段受峰值显存限制，传统压缩虽降低解码缓存，却仍需先完整构建全提示词KV。TideKV采用按层处理、层末延迟淘汰的调度，仅为当前层保留完整提示词KV，在全局上下文可见后再执行筛选。其保持压缩质量与最终缓存规模，并在64K上下文显著降低瞬时显存，占用受限设备也可完成128K预填充。该方法扩展了长上下文推理的可行范围。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.

papers.title_en: AdamPM: Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization via Moment Pooling
papers.authors: Xiaowei Ji, Lishan Xu, Jianing An, Jie Luo, Wenjun Wu, Lei Huang
papers.evidence: 直接服务大规模大模型训练的内存高效优化器
papers.tldr: 大语言模型训练常用 Adam，但其逐元素保存一阶、二阶矩会带来高昂优化器状态显存，现有节省方案又常牺牲速度或需额外调参。AdamPM将相邻行或列的矩条目分组，以共享均值表示一组状态，并系统比较两类矩的池化。结果表明仅池化二阶矩最有效：组大小为 s 时二阶矩内存降至原来的 1/s，同时保持预训练、微调和多模态任务的性能与训练速度。该方法可复用 Adam 超参数并易于接入现有实现，为低显存稳定训练提供了简单实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second moments incur substantial memory overhead. Although numerous memory-efficient optimizers have been proposed, many incur additional computational overhead or require additional tuning of hyperparameters. Consequently, Adam remains a dominant and reliable choice for LLM pre-training. We propose AdamPM (Adam with Pooled Moments), a simple and memory-efficient variant of Adam that groups adjacent moment entries along the row or column dimension and represents each group by a single shared mean. AdamPM can well inherit Adam's hyperparameter settings and is readily integrated into existing Adam optimizer implementations, with less memory overhead. We systematically investigate pooling of both first and second moment estimates and identify second moment pooling as the effective design. With a group size of $s$, AdamPM reduces second moment memory to $1/s$ of the original requirement. Extensive experiments on language model pretraining, fine-tuning and multimodal learning demonstrate that AdamPM maintains model performance and training speed while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/jixiaowei95/AdamPM}.

papers.title_en: gKSM: GPU Memory Deduplication at Driver Layer for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Shuheng Gao, Fan Guo, Yongkun Li, Ziye Yue, Yinlong Xu, John C. S. Lui
papers.evidence: 面向多实例大模型服务的驱动层GPU内存去重
papers.tldr: 无服务器大模型推理常在单块GPU并置多个实例，但模型权重与运行时状态各自保存，重复显存成为扩容瓶颈。gKSM在驱动层实现透明去重，协同CPU与GPU管理哈希、在传输前零拷贝合并权重，并借助内核钩子和CUDA VMM重映射处理写时隔离。实验相对ServerlessLLM节省59.8%显存，受限显存下聚合吞吐提升2.15倍、可并发5实例。该方案避免冗余主机—设备数据移动，并以稳定扫描和复用感知放置提升集群服务率。
papers.abstract_en: In serverless LLM inference, cloud providers commonly locate multiple instances on a single GPU to improve utilization. However, each instance independently maintains its model weights and runtime state, making duplicate GPU memory the primary bottleneck. Memory deduplication is a widely-used technique for eliminating duplicate data in CPU systems, but extending it to GPU memory faces fundamental challenges. Effective GPU memory deduplication must avoid redundant data movement between CPU and GPU while preserving write isolation for shared pages without native copy-on-write (COW) support.   This paper presents gKSM, a transparent GPU memory deduplication framework for serverless LLM inference. gKSM addresses these challenges through CPU-GPU collaborative hash management that offloads hash computation to GPU kernels, zero-copy model weight deduplication that eliminates duplication before model weight transfer, and a cross-privilege page fault handler that combines a lightweight kernel hook and CUDA Virtual Memory Management (VMM) remapping in the user space. gKSM also designs a stable page scanning algorithm and a reuse-aware placement policy in cluster scale. Experiments show that gKSM reduces GPU memory usage by 59.8% while maintaining high throughput compared to ServerlessLLM. Under memory constrained workloads, gKSM improves aggregate throughput by 2.15X and supports five instances concurrently. In cluster level simulation, gKSM achieves a service rate of 99.97%, compared to 78.2% for SLInfer and 26.9% for ServerlessLLM.

papers.title_en: CoASFL: Coupled Consistency Optimization for Asynchronous Split Federated Learning
papers.authors: Junhao Cheng, Yunming Liao, Hongli Xu, Yang Xu, Zuan Xie
papers.evidence: 面向异构边缘客户端的异步切分联邦训练框架
papers.tldr: 异步拆分联邦学习虽能缓解设备异构导致的拖尾，却会在客户端之间产生横向不一致、在客户端与服务器间产生纵向不一致，并因数据非独立同分布而放大激活偏差、模型漂移和客户端漂移。CoASFL以动态激活合并构造更一致的激活序列，并按参与频率和训练进度差距自适应聚合模型。在80台异构边缘设备上，方法较现有方案提速1.61至3.74倍，最终精度最高提升3.26%。该工作通过联动激活层与模型层的一致性控制，抑制异步训练中的误差传播。
papers.abstract_en: Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices. Although asynchronous SFL alleviates the straggler bottleneck caused by system heterogeneity, it inevitably introduces two coupled dimensions of inconsistency: horizontal inconsistency across clients and vertical inconsistency between clients and the server. These inconsistencies, further exacerbated by statistical heterogeneity, result in biased activation representations, model divergence, and severe client drift. To address these challenges, we propose CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous SFL framework that incorporates a dynamic activation merging mechanism and a consistency-aware model aggregation mechanism. Specifically, CoASFL constructs more consistent activation sequences from heterogeneous clients to alleviate horizontal inconsistency, and dynamically adjusts aggregation weights according to client participation frequencies and progress gaps to mitigate vertical inconsistency. By jointly coordinating activation-level and model-level consistency, CoASFL effectively suppresses inconsistency propagation during asynchronous training. Extensive experiments on an 80-device heterogeneous edge testbed demonstrate that CoASFL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SFL approaches, accelerating training by 1.61$\times$ to 3.74$\times$ and improving final model accuracy by up to 3.26\% under heterogeneous scenarios.

papers.authors: Samkit Jain, Sai Kishan Pampana, Shlok Agarwal
papers.evidence: 面向vLLM稀疏注意力推理的系统优化
papers.tldr: 稀疏注意力虽只保留少量键值，但各层为寻找候选仍可能扫描完整前缀，成为长上下文推理瓶颈。MLIPS让生产层发布大于注意力预算的前M候选池，后续消费者层在池内按自身评分选取前K，不共享最终选择。vLLM实现层间共享、解码复用与粗粒度生产器；四项长上下文测试中，每个生产层服务三层消费者可获1.14至1.40倍加速、GPU能耗降14.8%至27.4%。结果表明跨层共享候选工作集可在基本维持精度下减少检索成本，但扩大共享会带来任务相关质量损失。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention limits the keys used by each query, but finding those keys can still require a full-prefix scan at every layer. We introduce \textbf{MLIPS (Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing)}, a training-free method that shares candidate search while retaining each consumer's own scoring and selection. A producer publishes a top-$M$ pool larger than the attention budget $K$; subsequent layers select their own top-$K$ from that pool. Measurements across three sparse-attention model families show substantially higher coverage from broad pools than overlap between final selections. We implement layerwise sharing, persistent decode reuse, and a coarse producer in vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Across four long-context suites, three consumer layers per producer give $1.14$--$1.40\times$ speedups and $14.8$--$27.4\%$ lower GPU energy, with observed accuracy changes of $-1.49$ to $+0.29$ percentage points in single runs. More extensive sharing exposes task-dependent quality losses. Sampled prefill traces also reveal recurring selected KV positions across query groups and layers. We characterize this shared working-set structure and use it to motivate Top-$G$, an exploratory bounded pool construction for prefill. Its deployment, task accuracy, and serving benefits remain open.

papers.title_en: From Partitioning to Provisioning: Co-Designing DNN Deployment and Infrastructure Capacity
papers.authors: Zongyao Huang, Fan Yang, Qi Cao, Yulin Shao
papers.evidence: 分布式DNN部署划分与基础设施容量协同设计
papers.tldr: 现有DNN分割推理多假设计算与通信能力固定，但当资源不足时，仅优化模型部署无法满足时延与吞吐需求。论文面向流水线推理，将网络分割、节点计算容量和链路通信容量的扩容统一协同设计。针对无环网络，作者揭示耦合优化可精确改写为最短路径问题，从而在多项式时间获得全局最优解。数值实验表明，该方案优于先部署后扩容或分离决策，为按推理需求规划基础设施提供了可解且有效的框架。
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural network (DNN) partitioning enables distributed inference by dividing model computation across interconnected devices. Existing approaches have largely focused on optimizing DNN deployment over infrastructure with fixed computing and communication capacities. Yet when these resources cannot adequately support inference demands, optimizing deployment alone is insufficient: the supporting infrastructure must also be provisioned. Crucially, deployment and provisioning are inherently coupled. How a DNN is partitioned determines where capacity is needed, while capacity provisioning can fundamentally change the preferred deployment. Motivated by this interdependence, we investigate the co-design of DNN deployment and infrastructure capacity for pipelined inference. Despite the coupling between these decisions, we reveal an efficiently solvable structure: on acyclic networks, the problem admits an exact shortest-path reformulation, enabling globally optimal joint design in polynomial time. Numerical evaluations demonstrate the benefits of co-design over treating deployment and provisioning separately, highlighting the potential of inference-driven infrastructure planning.

papers.title_en: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Francesco Giulio Blanco, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Davide Patti, Maurizio Palesi
papers.evidence: 面向深度神经网络工作负载的强化学习加速器调度与运行时保障
papers.tldr: 异构多加速器同时承载硬实时与软实时 DNN 推理时，既要确保硬截止期，又要提升面向服务质量的资源利用，传统固定策略难以兼顾。论文以在线强化学习联合决定子任务优先级和加速器分配，并由确定性安全层实时认证候选调度。其基于按机器切分的前缀替换准则，在不要求完整完工时间支配的条件下保证存在可行后续。实验显示，该框架始终保持硬实时可调度性，并提升软实时截止期满足率、客户服务质量和加速器利用率。
papers.abstract_en: We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.   To enable runtime certification in heterogeneous precedence-constrained systems, we introduce a schedulability-preserving prefix replacement criterion based on machine-wise cuts. The proposed criterion guarantees that runtime-generated schedule prefixes preserve the existence of a feasible continuation without requiring complete finish-time dominance with respect to a feasible reference schedule.   Experimental results on heterogeneous DNN accelerator platforms show that the proposed framework preserves HRT schedulability while improving QoS-aware deadline satisfaction, client-level service quality, and accelerator utilization compared to state-of-the-art scheduling approaches.

papers.title_en: qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators
papers.authors: Leandro Fiorin, Luigi Altamura, Cristina Silvano
papers.evidence: 深度网络到加速器的映射与配置优化
papers.tldr: 面向同时支持多种定点与浮点精度的通用空间加速器，混合精度DNN的层级映射和硬件配置组合庞大，难以兼顾性能、能耗与资源。qGAMMA以领域专用遗传算法搜索映射及配置空间，并以基于综合结果的解析性能模型评估候选方案。跨多类DNN工作负载的实验表明，该框架能够找到目标指标最优的映射配置。其价值在于为混合精度应用与多精度加速器设计提供可量化的权衡依据。
papers.abstract_en: This work describes qGAMMA, a flexible framework for exploring and optimizing the mapping of mixed-precision Deep Neural Network (DNN) models onto general-purpose spatial accelerators that support a range of fixed- and floating-point precisions. qGAMMA navigates the design space using a domain-specific genetic algorithm and an analytical performance model based on hardware synthesis results. The framework identifies the optimal mapping and accelerator configuration that minimizes target metrics. Extensive evaluations across DNN workloads show that qGAMMA offers valuable insights for designing mixed-precision applications, enabling better trade-offs between performance, energy efficiency, and resource utilization.

papers.title_en: SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation
papers.evidence: 降低分布式深度学习通信与内存流量
papers.tldr: 高维输入向量在反复存储、传输和计算时会带来显著的内存流量与通信开销，现有模型压缩方法对此覆盖不足。论文提出SETAREH：先对固定系数与输入施加相同排序置换和Haar小波变换，再稀疏保留部分变换域系数对。实验表明，在高斯向量及APPA-REAL年龄估计任务中，该方法以远少于原始维度的系数近似内积。该工作为固定权重与连续输入场景提供了可控误差的结构化表示方案，但实际收益受精度及置换元数据成本制约。
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning systems increasingly rely on high-dimensional vector operations, in which large input and parameter vectors are repeatedly stored, transferred, and processed. Although substantial research has focused on reducing neural-network model size through pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architectures, the storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs associated with repeatedly presented high-dimensional input vectors remain important practical considerations, particularly in distributed and edge-computing environments. This paper proposes the SETAREH (Sorting-assisted Energy-concentrating Transform for Approximate Representation using Haar wavelets) transform, a Haar-wavelet-based sparsification approach for approximating the inner product between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors. By applying the same sequence of permutations and Haar transforms to both vectors, SETAREH preserves the exact inner product before truncation. It then retains only a subset of the transformed coefficient-input pairs, reducing their representation cost while introducing a controllable approximation error. To evaluate SETAREH, we consider two complementary experimental settings: a synthetic Gaussian-vector baseline and a real apparent-age estimation task using a convolutional neural network on the APPA-REAL dataset. The results show that SETAREH can approximate the evaluated inner products using substantially fewer transformed coefficient-input pairs than the original vector dimension. The findings support its use as a potential structured data-representation method for repeated inner products with fixed weights, while the practical benefit depends on approximation accuracy and the cost of storing or transmitting permutation metadata.

papers.title_en: HydraLLM: Adaptive Width Slicing for Elastic Text and Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Oscar Kemme, Janek Haberer, Ali Hojjat, Olaf Landsiedel
papers.evidence: 适配异构部署目标的弹性大模型架构
papers.tldr: 大语言与视觉语言模型需适配从数据中心到边缘设备的多样算力，但固定宽度模型难以复用。HydraLLM以激活注意力头数统一控制嵌入、注意力、前馈层及输出层宽度，并通过权重重排和蒸馏训练获得嵌套子网。75%头数时其TriviaQA准确率比参数更多的嵌套基线高2.2个百分点，25%头数时生成吞吐提升75.3%。该方法还将弹性宽度扩展至多模态投影，为单一参数集覆盖更广部署目标提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: LLMs and LVLMs are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware, ranging from data-center GPUs to resource-constrained edge devices. Their fixed-size architectures limit the ability to reuse a single model across deployment settings with different compute, latency, and model-size targets. We introduce HydraLLM, an elastic MQA-based architecture. Its number of active attention heads determines the effective widths of the embeddings, attention projections, feed-forward layers, and the output head, forming a nested family of subnetworks within a single parameter set. We introduce a static-to-elastic conversion pipeline that, starting from a pre-trained model checkpoint, includes importance-driven weight reordering and stochastic subnetwork training with knowledge distillation. We extend this principle to multimodal inference through an elastic projection module whose output width follows the active text width. HydraLLM covers a wider range of active parameter configurations than FFN-only elastic architectures. With 75% of heads active, HydraLLM achieves 2.2 percentage points higher TriviaQA accuracy than a state-of-the-art nested baseline configuration which has 17.25% more parameters. With 50% of heads active, our multimodal model achieves a CLIPScore comparable to that of the 7$\times$ larger Gemma 3 4B model. With only 25% of heads active, HydraLLM increases token-generation throughput by 75.3% over the full-width configuration.

papers.title_en: HEL: A Heterogeneous Extensible Layer for GPU-Resident Runtime Orchestration
papers.authors: Agnieszka M. Łupińska, Serban D. Porumbescu, John D. Owens
papers.evidence: 面向空间分区GPU的运行时编排与任务调度
papers.tldr: 传统 GPU 运行时难以高效编排长期存活、依赖复杂且同步与异步混合的细粒度任务，低利用率场景中的调度与等待开销尤为突出。HEL 在 GPU 内常驻有状态服务，将应用表示为协程式任务并由运行时调度执行。它支持运行时依赖、批量提交、自动重试及空间分区并行共存。在生产者—消费者、主机远程调用和 PFPL 压缩中，HEL 可在资源未充分利用或可隐藏延迟时取得性能优势，为 GPU 端运行时编排提供可扩展抽象。
papers.abstract_en: We describe a GPU-resident runtime system, HEL, built on stateful services that persist throughout the lifespan of a user application. A HEL programmer expresses a workload as an application that spawns coroutine-like tasks, which are then scheduled and run by the HEL runtime. HEL supports synchronous and asynchronous tasks, tasks with runtime dependencies, batched task submission, and automatic retries. Applications and tasks run alongside each other on the spatially partitioned GPU. Using producer-consumer and host-RPC benchmarks together with a PFPL compression case study, we show that HEL demonstrates a performance advantage for underutilized GPUs and for scenarios where HEL enables hiding task latency.

papers.title_en: DROD: Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout for Federated Continual Learning on Heterogeneous Devices
papers.evidence: 面向异构设备能力的联邦训练
papers.tldr: 面向设备算力与模型容量不一、且客户端数据随时间持续漂移的联邦持续学习，现有方法较少同时处理两类异质性。论文提出双比例有序丢弃DROD，以捷径比例和分支比例两条独立轴提取不同规模子模型。在Split-CIFAR-100的10个类增量任务上，DROD在共享参数与计算量预算阶梯下取得最高平均准确率。其优势跨回放缓存规模及多种持续学习策略保持稳定，为异构设备上的联邦持续学习提供更有效的模型几何设计。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning for capacity-heterogeneous clients and federated continual learning are each well studied on their own, but their intersection -- clients holding differently sized models while every client's data stream also drifts over time -- remains underexplored. We study this setting directly, training a ResNet-18 fleet from scratch on Split-CIFAR-100 (10 tasks, class-incremental), and introduce DROD (Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout), which builds on FjORD's Ordered Dropout by using two independent reduction axes to extract sub-models: a shortcut ratio and a branch ratio. On a shared parameter/FLOP budget ladder, DROD achieves the highest mean accuracy among the heterogeneous-model federated learning strategies we compare. Its advantage over the two strongest baseline geometries persists across every replay-buffer size we test and under ER, DER++, and BiC; under EWC, all three geometries collapse alike.

papers.title_en: PFedQFT: Personalized Federated Quantum-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Medical Large Language Models
papers.authors: Qihan Huang, Lingxia Zhang, Guye Zhang, Zizhu Wang, Xiaowei Mao
papers.evidence: 通信高效的个性化联邦大模型微调
papers.tldr: 医疗机构的数据受隐私、治理与所有权限制而难以集中，联邦微调虽可协作训练大模型，却面临多投影适配器重复开销和机构异质性聚合不足的问题。PFedQFT以量子启发方式构造可复用正交适配基，并结合共享核心与客户端私有残差实现个性化。七项公开医疗任务和多种大模型实验表明，其显著降低可训练参数及每轮上传量，同时在多数任务保持有竞争力的预测性能。该方法为低通信、可个性化的医疗大模型联邦适配提供了紧凑方案。
papers.abstract_en: Medical data remain fragmented across institutional silos because of privacy, governance, and ownership constraints. Federated learning enables medical institutions to adapt large language models (LLMs) collaboratively without transferring raw records. However, independently parameterized low-rank adapters incur repeated parameter and communication costs across Transformer projections, while uniform aggregation may limit adaptation to heterogeneous institutional data. We propose PFedQFT, a quantum-inspired framework for personalized federated fine-tuning with a compact shared adapter. Specifically, PFedQFT constructs reusable orthonormal adaptation bases from compact skew-symmetric generators using a truncated matrix-exponential approximation followed by QR orthonormalization. Compatible projections reuse these bases, while a globally shared full core preserves the flexibility of each projection. Each client further maintains a lightweight private residual operator, whose directions are learned globally and whose coefficients remain local. Experiments on seven public medical tasks and multiple LLM backbones show substantial reductions in trainable parameters and per-round adapter upload volume, with competitive predictive performance on most tasks.

papers.title_en: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
papers.authors: Woosang Lim, Haneul Yoo, Vincent-Daniel Yun, Sungjoo Yoo
papers.evidence: 面向高效部署的推理大模型结构化剪枝
papers.tldr: 结构化剪枝虽能降低大语言模型推理成本，但现有方法常在AIME等长链推理任务上显著损害能力。LayerTrim以无训练方式识别冗余解码层，仅裁剪其MLP特征，同时保留注意力模块和解码深度。在3个推理模型、5项基准上，它多数设置优于既有方法，较RESP平均准确率最高提升21.4个百分点。该方法还通过缩短生成长度叠加结构压缩收益，为兼顾推理质量与部署效率提供了方案。
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.

papers.title_en: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Shuoran Jiang, Wentao Zhu, Yang Xiang, Dongfeng Li, Yunan Zhang, Mengchen Zhao, Yuhui Guo, Kai Chen, Youcheng Pan, Xiangping Wu, Qingcai Chen
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的内存高效定向适配
papers.tldr: 大语言模型持续接收新指令时容易遗忘旧能力，且全参数更新带来较高优化器状态开销。论文借助梯度归因定位彼此重叠极低的认知功能子网络，并提出CiMEO，按样本路由并仅更新对应局部参数与状态。在140万条顺序指令、五类生成基准上，该方法取得最高平均性能并缓解灾难性遗忘。结果表明，功能隔离的局部可塑性可兼顾持续学习稳定性与资源效率。
papers.abstract_en: Biological intelligence continually adapts to new information while retaining prior skills through localized plasticity. In contrast, continual learning in large language models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. A promising direction is to identify functionally specialized subnetworks within LLMs that enable targeted and resource-efficient adaptation. Using gradient-attribution profiling, we localize cognition-associated functional subnetworks exhibiting extremely low mutual overlap. Building on this finding, we propose Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO), a continual learning framework that routes each training example to its corresponding functional subnetwork, restricting parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions. Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods on five generative benchmarks spanning programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Subspace-overlap and principal-angle analyses further indicate that localized updates help preserve pre-trained representations, highlighting functional subnetwork localization as a practical approach to efficient and stable continual learning in LLMs.

papers.title_en: Interfaces and Modules: A Scalable Representation for Weight-Space Learning across Architectures
papers.evidence: 面向跨架构权重学习的可扩展PyTorch编译表示
papers.tldr: 跨架构权重空间学习需同时处理参数置换对称性与大模型可扩展性，现有张量编码器依赖架构专属规则，神经元图全局注意力代价高。论文提出由接口与模块构成的类型化图，并由编译器从PyTorch模型自动恢复置换因子。通用权重编码器以局部等变更新结合接口摘要上的全局注意力。其在既有基准上具竞争力，并在含1200个Transformer、100种架构的新数据集上显著提升未见架构内模型排序，且更省显存。
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space learning across architectures requires representations that respect parameter symmetries and scale to large networks. Existing equivariant tensor encoders require architecture-specific symmetry specifications, while neuron graphs make global attention costly. We introduce a typed graph organized around shared coordinate-permutation actions. Its nodes, called interfaces, represent coordinate spaces whose bound tensor axes must be permuted jointly; operation occurrences, called modules, form typed hyperedges. A compiler derives this graph from supported PyTorch models, with exact recovery of the permutation factors defined by its constraints. The Universal Weight Encoder (UWE) combines local equivariant updates to parameter features with global attention over invariant interface summaries. The small number of interfaces makes global attention practical, and a single encoder processes different supported architectures. UWE is competitive with architecture-specific state-of-the-art methods on established benchmarks. On a new zoo of 1,200 transformers spanning 100 architectures, it outperforms the evaluated baselines at ranking networks within unseen architectures, including architectures larger than those used for training, while using substantially less memory.
